title: With diagnostic events on, every contract event appears twice
pattern: Galexie's default flags include ENABLE_SOROBAN_DIAGNOSTIC_EVENTS. The put's contract event appears in the operation's events and again, type contract, among the diagnostic events; a core_metrics event invoke_time_nsecs carries wall-clock time, so the bytes differ between nodes. stellar-etl#452.

hazards.placement: diagnostic events only under the galexie profile

facts.says: With Galexie flags, the diagnostic events include the contract event with topic put.
With base flags there are no diagnostic events.
